Applicability to the current Elsevier route is also unverified; the Oxford portal was reported as under development.

restrictions: AI cannot be an author; authors are accountable for their work.
Disclosure examples alone do not establish permission for the campaign workflow; staged Oxford terms must not be assumed to govern the current Elsevier portal.

policy_sources.note: The journal explicitly addresses AI for content generation, code and data processing, subject to disclosure and human authorship responsibility.

notes: Reviewed all 19 merged helper records and their fee, geography and AI-policy patch fields for internal consistency; independent official-source retrieval was targeted, not a fresh verification of every source. Official Swiss Society, Oxford guidance, Contextus and Afyon policy, EKOIST 2025 statistics, Economics and Business Letters metrics, and Comparative Economic Studies metrics were read. Other role observations are retained with their evidence and access limitations.

Existing sourced metrics retained, including official 2025 Comparative Economic Studies JIF 1.9 and five-year JIF 1.7, and EKOIST 2025 acceptance ratio 51% (36 accepted, 35 rejected; denominator/cohort limits noted). Economics and Business Letters 2025 JIF 1.0 and CiteScore 1.5 were confirmed. Citation metrics do not measure acceptance odds; no historical padding or inferred acceptance rate was added.
No independent live recheck of every fee, geographic claim or policy was possible in this review; unresolved or blocked policies remain uncertain. No remote actions.
